verified: Bloomberg published the report on the talks and the $33 billion target, against a $22 billion valuation reported in September; the figures come from people Bloomberg did not name.
unconfirmed: that a round will happen at all, who would invest, its size, its terms or its exact date, and the $700 million annual recurring revenue figure, which rests on the same unnamed sources and has not been independently audited or published by ElevenLabs.

verified: 彭博社报道称，ElevenLabs 正就一轮 2027 年融资进行早期讨论，消息来自未具名知情人士；报道同时提到其 9 月估值为 220 亿美元。
unconfirmed: 330 亿美元的目标估值、7 亿美元的年经常性收入、融资时间表与投资方均仅来自未具名消息人士，ElevenLabs 未公开确认，也没有独立第三方核实这些数字；报道未提及本轮拟募资金额。

titles.en: ElevenLabs in early talks for 2027 round at $33B target valuation, Bloomberg reports
titles.zh: ElevenLabs 传以 330 亿美元目标估值洽谈 2027 年融资，彭博报道
